create_debug_visualizer: create a DebugVisualizer instance from a Habitat Simulator to enable visual debugging
create_dbv_agent: create and register a debug agent and sensor on the simulator via create_dbv_agent
peek_scene: peek at the current scene visualization using dbv.peek with the scene mode
get_observation: render a debug observation image from the current camera position and look-at target
stitch_image_matrix: stitch a list of PIL images into a single grid matrix with configurable columns
